name: ux-design-mentor
description: Comprehensive UI/UX design evaluation, generation, and education plugin powered by 10 essential design books plus supplementary frameworks (Nielsen's heuristics, Laws of UX, Refactoring UI, Atomic Design, WCAG 2.2) — covering UX process, visual craft, design systems, and non-technical admin UX — now with internet image search/scraping for inspiration & mockup assets, and a Python image toolbox (palette, WCAG contrast, optimize, placeholders, favicons)
